collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A cook is famous for a fish stew that everyone loves, and a young villager asks how to make it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (Name1), a cook, is famous for a fish stew that everyone loves, and a young villager asks how to make it.

choices.label: Write the Recipe on a Piece of Bark.
Invite Everyone Interested to Cook Together.
Keep One Small Secret but Share the Rest.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The young villager makes a good stew and credits the cook for every bite.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The first try is a disaster, and the cook kindly teaches the hard parts again.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The recipe is misread, and one family's stew becomes very salty indeed.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Too many cooks argue over the pot, and the stew is only average.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Everyone's stew is good, and the cook's is still a little better.

b1__fx.name: Outcome B1
b1__fx.text: The bark is copied and passed around, and soon many families make the stew.

b1__text.name: Outcome B1

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The cooking lesson turns into a merry afternoon with a huge pot of stew.
